snippet.title: Earth Taken Full Walkthrough
snippet.description:
This is a full playthrough of Earth Taken; an apocalyptic action shooter by indie game designer SeethingSwarm. This walkthrough reveals all the secret areas. Don't watch this if you want to find and figure things out for yourself. Spoilers, duh! :)

Visit facebook.com/seethingswarm for info, videos and screenshots about Earth Taken and other game projects!
